SOURCE /home/ben/Moggie-wt/buildroot/buildroot.lock sha256=2e3de36dbb8eaa9c5262c1ac5f727228fdcb24900ac64a602fb5995e5580b23a lines=17-42
  17: # Target fact, repeated here because the rootfs build enforces it.
  18: ROOTFS_SLOT_BYTES=8388608        # 8 MiB per A/B slot
  19: ROOTFS_MAX_BYTES=7864320         # hard cap: half of the 16 MiB mtd3
  20: NAND_ERASEBLOCK=131072           # 128 KiB
  21:
  22: # Known incompatibility, deliberately not papered over
  23: # ----------------------------------------------------
  24: # The pinned toolchain is glibc 2.44 (Bootlin 2026.08-1). Its own libc
  25: # carries a .note.ABI-tag of "Linux, ABI: 3.2.0": glibc 2.34+ dropped
  26: # support for kernels older than 3.2. The target kernel is 2.6.35.
  27: #
  28: # The toolchain's kernel headers are 5.10, and Buildroot's external-toolchain
  29: # check is strict, so BR2_TOOLCHAIN_EXTERNAL_HEADERS_5_10 is the only value
  30: # that lets the build run. Consequences:
  31: #   * the rootfs is built against a 5.10 kernel API despite a 2.6.35 kernel;
  32: #   * binaries may call syscalls added after 2.6.35 (prlimit64 is 2.6.36 --
  33: #     one release later -- and glibc assumes it exists);
  34: #   * whether the image actually boots on the speaker is UNVERIFIED. It
  35: #     cannot be verified without the hardware, and qemu-user cannot model a
  36: #     2.6.35 kernel.
  37: # The only real fixes are a different C library (uClibc-ng/musl toolchain for
  38: # e300c3) or a much older glibc toolchain, both of which contradict the
  39: # pinned-toolchain requirement. Recorded here so nobody discovers it on the
  40: # bench and thinks the rootfs is at fault.
  41: GLIBC_MIN_KERNEL=3.2.0
  42: TARGET_KERNEL=2.6.35

SOURCE /home/ben/Moggie-wt/buildroot/scripts/build-rootfs.sh sha256=ad4c6510b59e97312d8683d331b5f54cbc74b3cd47bef8778fcce6f19f4dd16a lines=123-146
 123: TC_DIR="${MOGGIE_TOOLCHAIN_DIR:-${TOOLCHAIN26_PATH:-$REPO/toolchain/$TOOLCHAIN_DIR}}"
 124: TC_GCC="$TC_DIR/bin/${TOOLCHAIN_PREFIX}-gcc"
 125:
 126: ensure_toolchain() {
 127:     if [ ! -x "$TC_GCC" ]; then
 128:         say "toolchain missing at $TC_DIR"
 129:         say "fetching it (pinned in toolchain.lock)"
 130:         ./scripts/fetch-toolchain.sh || die "toolchain fetch failed"
 131:     fi
 132:     [ -x "$TC_GCC" ] || die "no cross gcc at $TC_GCC"
 133:     local ver sysroot abi
 134:     ver=$("$TC_GCC" -dumpversion)
 135:     sysroot=$("$TC_GCC" -print-sysroot)
 136:     say "toolchain $TC_DIR (gcc $ver)"
 137:
 138:     # The whole point of this toolchain is its kernel floor. Read it out of the
 139:     # libc's .note.ABI-tag instead of trusting the path it came from.
 140:     abi=$("${CROSS_READELF:-readelf}" -n "$sysroot/lib/libc.so.6" 2>/dev/null \
 141:           | sed -n 's/.*ABI: \([0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1)
 142:     say "libc kernel floor: ${abi:-unknown} (target kernel $TARGET_KERNEL)"
 143:     [ -n "$abi" ] || die "could not read the ABI tag from $sysroot/lib/libc.so.6"
 144:     [ "$abi" = "${TOOLCHAIN26_ABI_TAG:-2.6.35}" ] \
 145:         || say "WARNING: libc floor $abi is not ${TOOLCHAIN26_ABI_TAG:-2.6.35}; \
 146: this image will not run on the target kernel"

SOURCE /home/ben/Moggie-wt/buildroot/scripts/build-rootfs.sh sha256=ad4c6510b59e97312d8683d331b5f54cbc74b3cd47bef8778fcce6f19f4dd16a lines=204-254
 204: measure() {
 205:     local img="$BUILD/images/rootfs.squashfs"
 206:     [ -f "$img" ] || die "no squashfs at $img (build first)"
 207:
 208:     local unsq="$BUILD/host/bin/unsquashfs"
 209:     [ -x "$unsq" ] || unsq=$(command -v unsquashfs) || die "no unsquashfs"
 210:
 211:     local raw padded files inodes
 212:     raw=$(stat -c%s "$img")
 213:     # Round up to the NAND eraseblock: the flashable artifact must not straddle
 214:     # an eraseblock boundary, and the padded size is what has to fit the slot.
 215:     padded=$(( (raw + NAND_ERASEBLOCK - 1) / NAND_ERASEBLOCK * NAND_ERASEBLOCK ))
 216:
 217:     # Entry/inode counts from the image itself, not from the staging dir.
 218:     files=$("$unsq" -l "$img" | wc -l)
 219:     inodes=$("$unsq" -s "$img" | awk '/^Number of inodes/ {print $NF}')
 220:
 221:     local comp blocksize xattrs created
 222:     comp=$("$unsq" -s "$img" | awk '/^Compression/ {print $2}')
 223:     blocksize=$("$unsq" -s "$img" | awk '/^Block size/ {print $3}')
 224:     xattrs=$("$unsq" -s "$img" | awk '/^Number of xattr ids/ {print $NF}')
 225:     created=$("$unsq" -s "$img" | sed -n 's/^Creation or last append time //p')
 226:
 227:     # Artifacts: raw image, padded NAND image, sizes report.
 228:     mkdir -p "$OUT"
 229:     cp -f "$img" "$OUT/rootfs.squashfs"
 230:     cp -f "$img" "$OUT/rootfs.nand.img"
 231:     truncate -s "$padded" "$OUT/rootfs.nand.img"
 232:
 233:     {
 234:         echo "# Moggie rootfs measurements -- generated by scripts/build-rootfs.sh"
 235:         echo "buildroot_version=$BUILDROOT_VERSION"
 236:         echo "buildroot_sha256=$BUILDROOT_SHA256"
 237:         echo "toolchain=$TOOLCHAIN_DIR"
 238:         echo "source_date_epoch=$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH"
 239:         echo "compression=$comp"
 240:         echo "block_size=$blocksize"
 241:         echo "xattr_ids=$xattrs"
 242:         echo "image_creation_time=$created"
 243:         echo "raw_bytes=$raw"
 244:         echo "padded_bytes=$padded"
 245:         echo "nand_eraseblock=$NAND_ERASEBLOCK"
 246:         echo "slot_bytes=$ROOTFS_SLOT_BYTES"
 247:         echo "max_bytes=$ROOTFS_MAX_BYTES"
 248:         echo "headroom_raw=$((ROOTFS_MAX_BYTES - raw))"
 249:         echo "headroom_padded=$((ROOTFS_MAX_BYTES - padded))"
 250:         echo "entries=$files"
 251:         echo "inodes=$inodes"
 252:         echo "squashfs_sha256=$(sha256sum "$OUT/rootfs.squashfs" | awk '{print $1}')"
 253:         echo "nand_sha256=$(sha256sum "$OUT/rootfs.nand.img" | awk '{print $1}')"
 254:     } > "$OUT/rootfs.sizes.txt"

SOURCE /home/ben/Moggie-wt/buildroot/buildroot/board/moggie/post-build.sh sha256=813d7a06a5ad06922764c9c8871a1397a2235c401aaf9910dbc656c530d68364 lines=29-64
  29: find "$TARGET_DIR" -xdev -type d -exec chmod 0755 {} +
  30: find "$TARGET_DIR" -xdev -type f -exec chmod go-w {} +
  31:
  32: chmod 0700 "$TARGET_DIR/root"
  33: chmod 0600 "$TARGET_DIR/etc/shadow"
  34: chmod 0644 "$TARGET_DIR/etc/passwd" "$TARGET_DIR/etc/group"
  35: chmod 0755 "$TARGET_DIR/etc/init.d/rcS"
  36: chmod 0755 "$TARGET_DIR/usr/share/udhcpc/default.script"
  37:
  38: # Buildroot installs busybox 4755 unconditionally, even with
  39: # CONFIG_FEATURE_SUID off. Nothing on this device runs as a non-root user,
  40: # so a setuid-root busybox is pure escalation surface.
  41: chmod 0755 "$TARGET_DIR/bin/busybox"
  42:
  43: for d in /tmp /run /var/log /var/tmp /var/lock /jffs; do
  44:     [ -d "$TARGET_DIR$d" ] || mkdir -p "$TARGET_DIR$d"
  45:     chmod 0755 "$TARGET_DIR$d"
  46: done
  47:
  48: # --- writable-state indirections -----------------------------------------
  49: # Everything writable lives on tmpfs or jffs2. Dangling symlinks are fine:
  50: # sonosd falls back to its compiled-in defaults when /etc/sonosd.conf is
  51: # not readable.
  52: ln -sfn /run/resolv.conf  "$TARGET_DIR/etc/resolv.conf"
  53: ln -sfn /run              "$TARGET_DIR/var/run"
  54: ln -sfn /jffs/sonosd.conf "$TARGET_DIR/etc/sonosd.conf"
  55:
  56: # dropbear's package installs /etc/dropbear as a symlink to
  57: # /var/run/dropbear, which resolves onto the /run tmpfs. That is exactly
  58: # right for a read-only rootfs, so it is left alone.
  59:
  60: # --- one init entry point -------------------------------------------------
  61: # rcS starts everything explicitly and conditionally. Package S* scripts
  62: # would start sshd (and anything else) unconditionally, so they are not
  63: # shipped. Nothing in this rootfs needs them.
  64: rm -f "$TARGET_DIR"/etc/init.d/S*

   1: # Moggie static /dev -- used because the 2.6.35 kernel has no CONFIG_DEVTMPFS.
   2: #
   3: # <name>	<type>	<mode>	<uid>	<gid>	<major>	<minor>	<start>	<inc>	<count>

   5: # Modes are deliberately stricter than a desktop /dev: /dev/null etc. are

   7: # process on the speaker runs as root. At boot rcS mounts a tmpfs over /dev
   8: # and mdev recreates the normal modes there.

SOURCE /home/ben/Moggie-wt/buildroot/firmware/bootchooser/init sha256=eb5ef34d7a4a1dc9b797b0d8aeea02fbdf7305c9ae13d7dcc23a4e8c93636e5c lines=56-90
  56: # --- slot plumbing ----------------------------------------------------------
  57:
  58: # Resolve "rootfs_a"/"rootfs_b" through /proc/mtd: the kernel splits mtd3 with
  59: # CONFIG_MTD_CMDLINE_PARTS, so the names come from the cmdline the bootloader
  60: # passes, not from anything we can assume at compile time.
  61: mtd_block_for() { # partition name -> /dev/mtdblockN
  62:     _want=$1
  63:     [ -r /proc/mtd ] || return 1
  64:     while read -r _line; do
  65:         set -- $_line                     # mtd3: 01000000 00020000 "rootfs_a"
  66:         _dev=${1%:}
  67:         _name=$4
  68:         _name=${_name#\"}
  69:         _name=${_name%\"}
  70:         if [ "$_name" = "$_want" ]; then
  71:             echo "/dev/${_dev%mtd}mtdblock${_dev#mtd}"
  72:             return 0
  73:         fi
  74:     done < /proc/mtd
  75:     return 1
  76: }
  77:
  78: slot_dev() { # a|b -> device path
  79:     if [ "$SIM" = "1" ]; then
  80:         echo "$SLOT_DIR/slot_$1.img"
  81:         return 0
  82:     fi
  83:     mtd_block_for "rootfs_$1"
  84: }
  85:

SOURCE /home/ben/Moggie-wt/buildroot/firmware/bootchooser/init sha256=eb5ef34d7a4a1dc9b797b0d8aeea02fbdf7305c9ae13d7dcc23a4e8c93636e5c lines=219-251
 219:     # Record what we are actually booting. The updater must never infer the
 220:     # running slot from bootslot, which names the *next* boot and is rewritten
 221:     # whenever an update commits. Written here, before switch_root (and before
 222:     # the simulation branch, so the tests model what a real boot leaves behind).
 223:     write_state running_slot "$_slot" || msg "warning: cannot record running slot"
 224:
 225:     if [ "$SIM" = "1" ]; then
 226:         printf '%s\n' "$_slot" > "$SLOT_DIR/booted" 2>/dev/null
 227:         if [ -n "${MOGGIE_SIM_BOOT_HOOK:-}" ]; then
 228:             # shellcheck disable=SC2086
 229:             sh -c "$MOGGIE_SIM_BOOT_HOOK" "$PROG" "$_slot"
 230:         fi
 231:         exit 0
 232:     fi
 233:
 234:     if ! mount -t squashfs -o ro "$_dev" "$ROOT_MNT" 2>/dev/null; then
 235:         msg "mount of $_dev failed"
 236:         return 1
 237:     fi
 238:     if [ ! -x "$ROOT_MNT/sbin/init" ] && [ ! -x "$ROOT_MNT/init" ]; then
 239:         msg "slot $_slot has no /sbin/init or /init"
 240:         umount "$ROOT_MNT" 2>/dev/null
 241:         return 1
 242:     fi
 243:
 244:     # Hand the pseudo-filesystems over to the real root.
 245:     for _d in proc sys dev; do
 246:         [ -d "$ROOT_MNT/$_d" ] && mount --move "/$_d" "$ROOT_MNT/$_d" 2>/dev/null
 247:     done
 248:
 249:     _init=/sbin/init
 250:     [ -x "$ROOT_MNT/sbin/init" ] || _init=/init
 251:     exec switch_root "$ROOT_MNT" "$_init"

SOURCE /home/ben/Moggie/src/linux-2.6.35/fs/squashfs/super.c sha256=58cf52fcf62b03dd98a88ae74f9ecaa9d5606454a290eb278832db13ca8a8d83 lines=51-74
  51: static const struct squashfs_decompressor *supported_squashfs_filesystem(short
  52: 	major, short minor, short id)
  53: {
  54: 	const struct squashfs_decompressor *decompressor;
  55:
  56: 	if (major < SQUASHFS_MAJOR) {
  57: 		ERROR("Major/Minor mismatch, older Squashfs %d.%d "
  58: 			"filesystems are unsupported\n", major, minor);
  59: 		return NULL;
  60: 	} else if (major > SQUASHFS_MAJOR || minor > SQUASHFS_MINOR) {
  61: 		ERROR("Major/Minor mismatch, trying to mount newer "
  62: 			"%d.%d filesystem\n", major, minor);
  63: 		ERROR("Please update your kernel\n");
  64: 		return NULL;
  65: 	}
  66:
  67: 	decompressor = squashfs_lookup_decompressor(id);
  68: 	if (!decompressor->supported) {
  69: 		ERROR("Filesystem uses \"%s\" compression. This is not "
  70: 			"supported\n", decompressor->name);
  71: 		return NULL;
  72: 	}
  73:
  74: 	return decompressor;
